newsitem.title: UK: Eurobonds await 1.0 bln mark TMCC Euro-Asian bond.
newsitem.headline: Eurobonds await 1.0 bln mark TMCC Euro-Asian bond.

text.p: The main focus for the Wednesday Eurobond session would be a Toyota Motor Credit Corp (TMCC) 1.0 billion mark five-year Euro-Asian bond, due to be launched soon, dealers said.
Spread talk on the issue, the first mark-denominated Euro-Asian bond, was five to seven basis points over the September 2001 Bund, they said.
TMCC opened up the Euro-Asian sector last October with a $750 million five-year issue. The bonds are listed in Europe and Asia and thus targeted at investors in both continents.
Its most recent transaction was a $500 million five-year dollar Euro-Asian bond which was launched last week at 11 b.p. over U.S. Treasuries.
Also expected on Wednesday was a $300 million five-year Eurobond for Kyushu Electric Power Co, dealers said.
Merrill Lynch will lead manage the deal. Spread talk was around 20 b.p. over Treasuries.
On the emerging market side, Argentina was due to issue a 50 billion yen 8.5-year bond via Nikko. A coupon of around six percent was expected.
